mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past quarter signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the unemployment rate above 5.2% by more than 0.3 percentage points triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting market concerns about labor market weakening.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing above 5.2%+0.3pp, or the trigger does not precede the return movement (time lag > 20 days).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in both GDPC1 (total demand) and HOUST (industrial production demand) create a feedback loop of heightened consumer and business demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST show rising trends simultaneously, or their correlation with returns falls below 0.5 in a rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the INDPRO supply index above 105 (2017=100 baseline) signals potential supply glut, leading to inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite INDPRO exceeding 105, or the peak in INDPRO does not precede the return decline (time lag > 20 days).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (evidenced by FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5%), sustained rate hikes increase borrowing costs, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5% in a tightening regime, or the regime is not confirmed by FEDFUNDS' trajectory.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in UNRATE over the past week signals improving labor market conditions, leading to immediate boosts in corporate profits and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns fail to rise significantly when UNRATE shows a sustained downward trend, or the trend does not precede the return increase (time lag > 5 days).

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (GDPC1) alongside elevated supply (INDPRO) creates conflicting signals, with strong demand outpacing supply growth leading to inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly negative when both GDPC1 and INDPRO show rising trends, or their combined effect on returns is below -0.5 in a rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp upward crossing of the federal funds rate above 4.5% by more than 0.1 percentage points signals aggressive monetary tightening, raising borrowing costs and compressing equity valuations to drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.5%, or the trigger occurs without a subsequent return decline within the horizon.
